sourceItems.title: 2019年8月份居民消费价格同比上涨2.8%
normalizedClaims: August pork prices rose 46.7% YoY and 23.1% MoM, showing an accelerating hog-supply scarcity regime.

sourceItems.title: Glencore 2019 Half-Year Report
normalizedClaims: Glencore decided to place Mutanda on temporary care and maintenance by year end because weak/oversupplied cobalt conditions had made the operation uneconomic.
observedChanges: major cobalt supply is scheduled to exit by year end

sourceItems.title: China’s skepticism of Mutanda closure characteristic of short-term procurement strategy
normalizedClaims: Cobalt prices had risen more than 25% after the Mutanda closure announcement; Mutanda was expected to produce about 25kt in 2019 before suspension, while buyers still questioned near-term tightness because inventories/other projects remained.

sourceItems.title: Indonesia to ban export of nickel ore by January
normalizedClaims: Indonesia would stop all nickel ore exports from Jan 1, 2020, two years earlier than previously planned, applying to all grades and standing contracts.
observedChanges: future global nickel ore availability tightens abruptly
domestic Indonesian processing gains policy support

sourceItems.title: PC DRAM Contract Prices Stabilized in August and Will Likely Remain Steady in September
normalizedClaims: PC DRAM contract prices stabilized in August/September as OEM inventory building helped supplier inventories normalize; 2020 supplier bit-output growth was projected to be the lowest in a decade.
observedChanges: PC DRAM shifts from decline toward stability

sourceItems.title: Mobile DRAM Prices to Continue Declining by Over 10% in 3Q19
normalizedClaims: Mobile DRAM contract prices were still expected to decline 10-15% in 3Q because smartphone demand was weak and inventories remained elevated; Japan-Korea material tensions were not expected to materially constrain shipments.
observedChanges: mobile DRAM remains in downcycle despite supply headlines

sourceItems.title: 2019年8月挖掘机、装载机数据快报
sourceItems.publisher: 中国工程机械工业协会数据转载
normalizedClaims: August excavator sales were 13,843 units, +19.5% YoY; domestic +14.4%, exports +53.6%; Jan-Aug total +14.4%.
observedChanges: equipment demand reaccelerates with strong export breadth

sourceItems.title: 取消高速公路省界收费站重点工作进展情况通报（9月12日至18日）
sourceItems.publisher: 中国交通运输协会转载中国交通新闻网/交通运输部工作总指挥部
normalizedClaims: By Sep 18 nationwide ETC users reached 130.52m; 2019 new users were 53.96m, +70.48% from year-end, and weekly issuance reached 103.19% of task.
observedChanges: mandated ETC deployment and user issuance accelerate rapidly

sourceItems.title: 吉林省高速公路集团取消省界收费站工程通信专线招标
normalizedClaims: Official provincial implementation required communication links and system construction under the national project to cancel provincial toll stations, confirming real capex rather than only user-registration targets.
observedChanges: ETC policy converts into equipment/communications procurement

eventClusters.statement: The world's largest cobalt mine was scheduled to suspend production by year end, removing a material share of global supply and causing cobalt prices to rebound, while near-term tightness remained debated.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The closure changes future supply, but current inventories and other projects may delay physical tightness; separate immediate price reaction from medium-term earnings conversion.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share cobalt exposures have direct realized cobalt earnings and sufficient duration/valuation room after the supply-shock rerating?

eventClusters.statement: Indonesia accelerated a universal nickel ore export ban to Jan 1, 2020, creating a policy-driven future supply shock with different effects on non-Indonesian miners, Indonesian processors and stainless/battery users.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Do not merge miners and Indonesian downstream processors: the same ban can help one geography/business model and hurt another.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a clean A-share expression of global nickel scarcity or Indonesian downstream advantage without mapping opposite exposures together?

eventClusters.statement: Pork scarcity accelerated sharply in August, with prices +46.7% YoY and +23.1% MoM, implying a large near-term producer margin pool but an increasingly visible cycle.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: High prices accelerate breeding/supply restoration; distinguish current earnings from medium-term normalization.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which producers have sufficient surviving volume/cost advantage to convert scarcity prices into earnings before the cycle normalizes?

eventClusters.statement: A nationwide policy deadline was converting into rapid ETC user issuance and real toll-system/communications construction, creating a short-duration but measurable hardware/system deployment cycle.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The deadline is explicit and may make this a rapidly saturating one-off capex cycle. Deep research must test order conversion and whether price already reflects the finite deployment peak.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can listed ETC suppliers still convert the mandated 2019 buildout into under-reflected earnings, or is the one-off cycle already fully priced?

eventClusters.statement: August excavator demand reaccelerated to +19.5% YoY with exports +53.6%, extending a strong machinery cycle with broad physical confirmation.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The cycle is already mature; separate industry volume continuation from company-specific share/margin engines and late-cycle valuation.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Do leading machinery companies still have incremental earnings/share room after a multi-year upcycle?

eventClusters.statement: DRAM evidence was no longer one-directional: PC DRAM contract prices stabilized by August/September, while mobile DRAM remained in a material downcycle. Product-market decomposition is mandatory before any company mapping.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Do not average PC stabilization and mobile weakness into generic 'memory'. Split by product and realized company exposure.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Are there separate investable A-share hypotheses for PC-memory stabilization versus still-weak mobile memory, or should both fail closed for lack of direct exposure?

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff cobalt-equity price regime
normalizedClaims: Cobalt basket had +5.72pp 20d excess and +15.40pp 60d excess; 华友/寒锐 strongly outperformed while 洛阳钼业 lagged, so the supply-shock rerating was real but cross-sectional.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff nickel-theme price regime
normalizedClaims: Nickel basket was neutral: -1.61pp 20d excess and +0.61pp 60d excess, with only 青岛中程 showing strong 60d relative performance.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff pork-equity price regime
normalizedClaims: Pork basket had -11.45pp 20d excess but +4.92pp 60d excess; every frozen name underperformed over the final 20d, indicating a substantial equity reset while physical pork prices accelerated.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff ETC price regime
normalizedClaims: ETC basket had +4.05pp 20d excess and +20.37pp 60d excess; 万集 and 金溢 had large 60d reratings, while 千方 was roughly benchmark-like.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff construction-machinery price regime
normalizedClaims: Machinery basket had +8.68pp 20d excess and +16.54pp 60d excess with 100% positive breadth; strong but broadly confirmed rather than one-stock concentration.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff memory-theme price regime
normalizedClaims: Generic memory-theme basket had +8.24pp 20d and +63.93pp 60d excess with full breadth. This is only an absorption diagnostic and cannot substitute for product-level PC/mobile DRAM mapping.

evidenceDocuments.title: 三一重工2019年半年度报告摘要
normalizedClaims: H1 revenue RMB43.386bn +54.27%, attributable profit RMB6.748bn +99.14%, operating cash flow RMB7.595bn +22.10%; realized earnings quality was strong before the September cutoff.

evidenceDocuments.title: 三一重工半年报点评：盈利能力持续提升，现金流再创历史新高
normalizedClaims: H1 revenue +54.27%, profit +99.14%, Q2 profit +86.77%; gross/net margins improved and H1 operating cash flow was RMB7.595bn, confirming a realized company engine.

evidenceDocuments.title: 恒立液压2019年半年度报告
normalizedClaims: H1 attributable profit was RMB670.8m, +44.74% YoY; company remained directly exposed to excavator hydraulic cylinders and pump/valve localization.

evidenceDocuments.title: 恒立液压2019年半年报点评
normalizedClaims: Forecast 2019/20/21 EPS 1.37/1.64/1.92 and PE 20.84x/17.48x/14.86x, providing an explicit multi-period baseline.

evidenceDocuments.title: 金溢科技2019年半年度报告摘要
normalizedClaims: H1 revenue RMB333.35m +46.23%; attributable profit RMB45.03m versus a prior-year loss, showing ETC demand already converting into profit.

evidenceDocuments.title: 金溢科技重大ETC供货合同摘要
normalizedClaims: By Sep 2 the company had disclosed major OBU supply agreements with Jiangsu and Shandong ETC operators, confirming the policy buildout had converted into company orders before cutoff.

evidenceDocuments.title: 万集科技2019年半年度报告
normalizedClaims: H1 revenue RMB324.28m +48.08%; net loss narrowed to RMB11.29m. ETC revenue was RMB209m +138.76%, with OBU sales RMB180m; company expanded production lines for the nationwide policy ramp.

evidenceDocuments.title: 万集科技2019年前三季度业绩预告
normalizedClaims: Company forecast 1-9M attributable profit RMB70-90m, +537.9% to +663.1%, citing larger OBU purchasing, released Q3 capacity and sharply higher shipments.

evidenceDocuments.title: 华友钴业：MB钴价继续上行，业绩将迎来拐点
normalizedClaims: H1 revenue RMB9.104bn +34% but profit RMB32.83m -98% due cobalt-price collapse and RMB326m inventory write-down. Cobalt output +18% and sales +37%. Forecast EPS 0.36/1.04/3.15 for 2019/20/21, PE 69.3x/24.1x/7.9x at RMB25.08.

evidenceDocuments.title: 洛阳钼业2019年半年度报告
normalizedClaims: CMOC controlled TFM copper-cobalt operations in DRC and had direct cobalt exposure, but H1 DRC-area revenue fell 47.15%; copper-cobalt assets contributed only RMB78.98m attributable profit in H1, showing current earnings weakness.

evidenceDocuments.title: 牧原股份2019年半年度报告
normalizedClaims: H1 hog sales 5.815m head +22.58%, revenue RMB7.16bn +29.87%; Q1 was loss-making under ASF and low prices, but rising Q2 hog prices moved the company back into profitability while unit cost remained low.

evidenceDocuments.title: 盛屯矿业印尼3.4万吨高冰镍项目投资公告
normalizedClaims: Company committed to an Indonesian 34kt nickel-metal matte project with expected future economics, but the asset was still a construction/investment project and had not yet created realized nickel earnings at cutoff.
